module case6(input logic [1:0] state, output logic [2:0] light);
    always_comb begin
        case(state)
            2'b00: light = 3'b100; // Red
            2'b01: light = 3'b010; // Yellow
            2'b10: light = 3'b001; // Green
            default: light = 3'b100;
        endcase
    end
endmodule

module case14(input logic [1:0] op, input logic [3:0] a, b, output logic [3:0] result);
    always_comb begin
        case(op)
            2'b00: result = a ^ b; // XOR
            2'b01: result = ~(a & b); // NAND
            2'b10: result = a | b; // OR
            2'b11: result = a & b; // AND
        endcase
    end
endmodule

module case31(input logic [3:0] value, output logic flag);
    always_comb begin
        case(value)
            4'd1, 4'd3, 4'd5, 4'd7: flag = 1; // odd numbers
            default: flag = 0;
        endcase
    end
endmodule

module case34(input logic [3:0] level, output logic alarm);
    always_comb begin
        case(level)
            4'd0, 4'd1, 4'd2: alarm = 0;   // safe range
            4'd3, 4'd4, 4'd5, 4'd6: alarm = 1; // warning range
            4'd7, 4'd8, 4'd9, 4'd10: alarm = 1; // critical range
            default: alarm = 0;
        endcase
    end
endmodule

module case35(input logic [3:0] digit, output logic display);
    always_comb begin
        case(digit)
            4'd0, 4'd2, 4'd4, 4'd6, 4'd8: display = 1; // even numbers
            4'd1, 4'd3, 4'd5, 4'd7, 4'd9: display = 0; // odd numbers
            default: display = 0;
        endcase
    end
endmodule

module case40(input logic [3:0] req, output logic [1:0] grant);
    always_comb begin
        case(req)
            4'd1, 4'd2: grant = 2'b00; // low priority
            4'd3, 4'd4, 4'd5: grant = 2'b01; // medium priority
            4'd6, 4'd7: grant = 2'b10; // high priority
            4'd8, 4'd9: grant = 2'b11; // highest priority
            default: grant = 2'b00;
        endcase
    end
endmodule

module case41(input int temp, output logic warning);
    always_comb begin
        case (temp) inside
            [0:10]:   warning = 0;  // safe
            [11:20]:  warning = 1;  // moderate
            [21:30]:  warning = 1;  // high
            default: warning = 1;   // out of range
        endcase
    end
endmodule

module case43(input int temp, output logic [1:0] fan_speed);
    always_comb begin
        case (temp) inside
            [0:25]:    fan_speed = 2'd0; // off
            [26:50]:   fan_speed = 2'd1; // low
            [51:75]:   fan_speed = 2'd2; // medium
            [76:100]:  fan_speed = 2'd3; // high
            default:   fan_speed = 2'd0;
        endcase
    end
endmodule

module case44(input int load, output logic [2:0] power);

module case48(input int hp, output logic [1:0] status);
    always_comb begin
        case (hp) inside

module nested_case_24(input logic [7:0] opcode, input logic [3:0] param, output logic [7:0] result);
always_comb begin
  case(opcode)
    8'hA0, 8'hA1, 8'hA2: begin
      case(param)
        4'h0, 4'h1: result = 8'h01;
        4'h2, 4'h3: result = 8'hxx;  // All x's
        default: result = 8'h00;
      endcase
    end
    8'hB0: result = 8'hzz;  // All z's
    8'b1010xxxx: result = 8'hFF;  // Range with x's
    default: result = 8'h00;
  endcase
end
endmodule

module nested_case_25(input logic [2:0] state, input logic [1:0] cond, output logic [1:0] status);
always_comb begin
  case(state)
    3'b0?1: begin  // Middle bit don't care
      case(cond)
        2'b0x: status = 2'b01;
        2'bz?: status = 2'b10;  // Second bit don't care
        default: status = 2'b00;
      endcase
    end
    3'b10?: status = 2'bzz;  // Output high impedance
    3'b11x: status = 2'bxx;  // Output unknown
    default: status = 2'b00;
  endcase
end
endmodule

module nested_case_26(input logic [3:0] cmd, input logic [2:0] arg, output logic [7:0] value);
always_comb begin
  case(cmd)
    4'b001x: begin  // Last bit x
      case(arg)
        3'b001: value = 8'h11;
        3'b01x: value = 8'h22;
        3'b1z0: value = 8'hzz;  // High impedance
        default: value = 8'h00;
      endcase
    end
    4'b010z: value = 8'h33;  // z in case item
    4'b1000, 4'b1001, 4'b1010: value = 8'h44;  // Multiple values
    default: value = 8'h00;
  endcase
end
endmodule

module nested_case_28(input logic [4:0] addr, input logic [1:0] mode, output logic valid);
always_comb begin
  case(addr)
    5'b0000?: begin  // Last bit don't care
      case(mode)
        2'b01: valid = 1'b1;
        2'b1x: valid = 1'bz;  // High impedance
        default: valid = 1'b0;
      endcase
    end
    5'b0010?: valid = 1'b1;  // Range pattern
    5'b0100?, 5'b0101?: valid = 1'bx;  // Multiple patterns
    default: valid = 1'b0;
  endcase
end
endmodule

module nested_case_29(input logic [2:0] op, input logic [1:0] param, output logic [2:0] result);
always_comb begin
  case(op)
    3'b0?0: begin  // Middle bit don't care
      case(param)
        2'b0z: result = 3'b001;
        2'bz0: result = 3'b010;
        2'bxx: result = 3'bxxx;  // All x's output
        default: result = 3'b000;
      endcase
    end
    3'b10x: result = 3'bzzz;  // All z's output
    3'b11?: result = 3'b111;  // Last bit don't care
    default: result = 3'b000;
  endcase
end
endmodule

module nested_case_30(input logic [3:0] code, input logic [2:0] flags, output logic [1:0] state);
always_comb begin
  case(code)
    4'h0, 4'h1, 4'h2: begin  // Multiple hex values
      case(flags)
        3'b001: state = 2'b01;
        3'b01x: state = 2'b10;
        3'b1z0: state = 2'bzz;  // High impedance
        default: state = 2'b00;
      endcase
    end
    4'h3, 4'h4: state = 2'bxx;  // Unknown
    4'h5, 4'h6, 4'h7: state = 2'b11;  // Range of values
    default: state = 2'b00;
  endcase
end
endmodule

module nested_case_37(input logic [3:0] temp_range, input logic [1:0] fan_speed, output logic [1:0] status);
always_comb begin
  case(temp_range)
    4'hA: begin  // High temperature
      case(fan_speed)
        2'b11: status = 2'b11;  // Max cooling
        2'b10: status = 2'b10;
        default: status = 2'b01;
      endcase
    end
    4'h5: status = 2'b00;  // Normal temperature
    default: status = 2'b00;
  endcase
end
endmodule

module nested_case_63(input logic [2:0] light_mode, input logic [1:0] dimmer_setting, output logic [2:0] light_output);
always_comb begin
  case(light_mode)
    3'b010: begin  // Ambient lighting mode
      case(dimmer_setting)
        2'b00: light_output = 3'b001;  // Low
        2'b01: light_output = 3'b011;  // Medium
        2'b10: light_output = 3'b111;  // High
        default: light_output = 3'b000;  // Off
      endcase
    end
    3'b100: light_output = 3'b111;  // Full brightness mode
    default: light_output = 3'b000;  // Off
  endcase
end
endmodule

module phy_link (
    input logic clk,
    input logic [3:0] mode,
    output logic [1:0] speed,
    output logic training
);
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        casez (mode)
            4'b1???: speed <= 2'b11;   // Gen3
            4'b01??: speed <= 2'b10;   // Gen2
            4'b001?: speed <= 2'b01;   // Gen1
            4'b0001: speed <= 2'b00;   // Safe
        endcase
    end

    always_ff @(posedge clk)
        training <= (speed != 2'b00);
endmodule

module case_temp_ctrl(input logic clk, rst, heat, cool, output logic [3:0] temp);
always_ff @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
  if (rst) temp <= 4'b0110;
  else begin
    case(temp) inside
      [0:3]: temp <= heat ? temp + 2 : temp;  // Too cold
      [4:7]: begin                            // Comfort zone
        if (heat) temp <= temp + 1;
        if (cool) temp <= temp - 1;
      end
      [8:11]: temp <= cool ? temp - 2 : temp; // Too hot
      [12:15]: temp <= 4'b0110;               // Reset to middle
    endcase
  end
end
endmodule

module case_sample_hold(input logic clk, rst, sample, hold, output logic [3:0] value);
always_ff @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
  if (rst) value <= 4'b0000;
  else begin
    case({sample, hold})
      2'b10: value <= value + 1;  // Sample - increment
      2'b01: value <= value - 1;  // Hold - decrement
      2'b11: value <= 4'b1000;    // Both - reset to middle
      default: value <= value;    // Neither - hold value
    endcase
  end
end
endmodule
